protocol:
1. Put on blue nitrile gloves and stand at the laboratory bench with a tube rack, blue-capped sample tubes, a marker, paper notes, and benchtop equipment.

2. Pick up a blue-capped tube from the bench area and handle it by hand at the workspace.

3. Open and close the blue-capped tube while standing over the bench.

4. Inspect the tube contents and cap area by holding the tube close to eye level.

5. Place the handled tube back on the bench near the other blue-capped tubes.

6. Leave the bench briefly and return to the same workspace.

7. Retrieve additional lab consumables from the bench area and place them near the blue-capped tubes.

8. Arrange the blue-capped tubes together in a rack on the benchtop.

9. Handle individual tubes from the rack and return them to the rack after inspection.

10. Pick up a black marker from the bench.

11. Write information on the paper notes or labeling surface using the black marker.

12. Set the marker down on the bench next to the notes.

13. Move the rack of blue-capped tubes to the right side of the workspace.

14. Consult the open notebook or protocol sheet on the bench.

15. Pick up a blue-capped tube from the rack and hold it while reading the notes.

16. Return the tube to the rack after checking it against the notes.

17. Continue writing on the notes with the marker while the tube rack remains on the bench.

18. Walk to the right side of the bench toward the benchtop equipment.

19. Position the rack or tube set beside the right-side benchtop instrument.

20. Operate the right-side benchtop instrument while keeping the blue-capped tubes nearby.
